lines.en: I tread the village's dirt road.
Iron feet land with a thud.
Butterflies rest on my shoulders.
I patrol this street slowly.
I raise a hand and let the butterflies go first.
The blooms on my arm sway as I walk.
I skirt the garden, sparing the sprouts.

lines.zh: 我走过花畦，尽量不踩倒花。
lines.en: I cross the flower rows, careful not to crush them.
My shadow covers the chickens.
I walk the village wall's length.
Wind rattles the flowers on me.
I pause at the gate.
I cross the mud, leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 我避开孩子跑过的地方。
lines.en: I avoid where the children run.
My steps startle the butterflies up.
I walk slowly, wary of bumping anyone.
I stand, butterflies covering my back.
Vines have grown over my iron.
I hold still so they won't fly off.
I lower my head to a flower.
Petals are wedged in my joints.

lines.zh: 我的肩头停着两只蝴蝶。
lines.en: Two butterflies rest on my shoulders.
I open my hand and a butterfly lands.
I count how many rest on me.
Sun warms my iron plating.
I slowly turn toward the gate.
A new bloom opened on the vine.
I stand like a flower bed.
You don't look like a villager.
These butterflies don't bite.
You've stood here a long while.
I know every face in the village.
By the flowerbed, my fist is clenched.

lines.zh: 我胸口那朵蝶，翅膀动了一下。
lines.en: The butterfly on my chest stirs its wings.

lines.zh: 我低头看你手上的东西。
lines.en: I look down at what you hold.
I guard this village.
Who are you looking for?

lines.zh: 蝶落在我眼前，挡了下视线。
lines.en: A butterfly lands before my eyes, blurring my view.
A dent in my plating.
Several vines are snapped.
The butterflies scatter.
No pain, only weight.
Petals fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，蝶翼也停了。
lines.en: A joint seized, and my butterfly wings stopped.
I raise a hand to shield the flowers.
I can bear this damage.
Don't tread on the butterflies.
I still have a village to patrol.
Flowers? I'm covered in them.
The butterflies would like that.
You'd have me take it?
I can swallow nothing.
Set it down, they'll come.
That colour suits me.
That bloom in your hand is fresh.
I shouldn't take a villager's things.
I raise a hand and decline.
Best you keep it.
You hit iron plating.
I step back, afraid of crushing you.
The butterflies burst up.
That bump is nothing.
Rust smeared your hand.
I raise a hand to steady you.
One vine snapped when I lurched.

lines.zh: 我身上的蝴蝶，被你惊飞了。
lines.en: You startled the butterflies off me.
I turned aside as much as I could.
You stepped on fallen petals.
I'm made of iron.
The village has no need for that.
My hands are all vines.
I'm only a guardian.
The butterflies would circle you.
I don't quite understand that question.
You should speak with the villagers.
Standing is enough for me.
I've watched many blooms come and go.
Let me walk you to the gate.
A fallen bloom, I pick it up.
I tuck it back into the vine.
That iron scrap fell off me.

lines.zh: 我拾起落地的花瓣，放回花丛。
lines.en: I pick up fallen petals and set them back in the bed.
A button on the ground.

lines.zh: 一枚蛹壳，我轻轻托在掌心。
lines.en: A chrysalis shell; I hold it gently.

lines.zh: 我把它放在村口的石上。
lines.en: I set it on the gate stone.
My iron hand nearly crushed it.
I'll give it to the villagers.
A butterfly lands on what I picked up.
You're heading deep into the village.
My steps have grown heavy.
Raiding isn't allowed here.

lines.zh: 花圃是我的，你踩进来了。
lines.en: This garden is mine; you stepped in.
You carry something meant to hurt.
The butterflies have all flown.
I slowly turn toward you.
I dislike fighting, but I will.
The villagers are behind me.

lines.zh: 我替铁傀儡站着，翅膀在抖。
lines.en: I stand in for the iron golem, wings quivering.
One step covers yards.
You've backed to the garden edge.
My hand can catch you.
Butterflies circle you in the air.
There are no dark alleys here.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠上我的手腕，我不挣。
lines.en: Vines wrap my wrist; I do not pull free.
Your blade won't cut through me.
Don't drag the villagers into this.
I count your ways out.
The last one is the village gate.
My iron arm sweeps across.
You're lifted and thrown.
My backhand hits your shoulder.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶落在我肩上，我不动。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on me and I hold still.
Vines snag your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸进土里，溅起花瓣。
lines.en: My fist smashes the soil and throws up petals.
Butterflies scatter as I strike.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶停在我拳头上，然后我出手。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my fist, then I swing.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着翅膀的震动。
lines.en: This punch carries a flutter of wings.
You should leave the village.
An iron shape rises at the gate.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶先飞来，我随后成形。
lines.en: Butterflies come first, then I take shape.

lines.zh: 藤和花盖住了我的铁身。
lines.en: Vines and blooms cover my iron.
I land and the ground dips.
The villagers look up at me.
I spread my arms slowly.
A flock of butterflies circles me.

lines.zh: 我站在最需要守的位置。
lines.en: I take the spot most in need of guarding.
My head turns to the gate.
I'll watch over this village.
Fire has burned my vines.
I land and leave a crater.
River water is cold, I sink fast.
The blast strips every flower.
An arrow wedges in my shoulder seam.
Magic makes my iron run hot.
My strength comes from the village.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，火花四溅。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and sparks fly.
No village to guard in the void.
